description: Fetch a single participant by GrowSurf participant ID or email address. `referralStatus` describes credit to their referrer; `referralCount` counts referrals this participant generated, so zero is consistent with `CREDIT_AWARDED`. In `rewards`, `approved` records approval; `status`, `isFulfilled`, and `fulfilledAt` record fulfillment marking, not confirmation of delivery. Use `growsurf_list_participants` first if you need to find a participant ID. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Pass the `id` returned by growsurf_create_campaign to configure or operate a program you just created, without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_get_participant

affiliateEnrollmentSource.description: Affiliate programs only. How the affiliate enrolled (`OPEN_ENROLLMENT`, `APPLICATION`, `PARTICIPANT_AUTH`, `INVITE`, `REST_API`, `CSV`, or `DASHBOARD`). `null` when not recorded.

affiliateStatus.description: Affiliate programs only. The enrolled affiliate's status (`APPROVED`, `SUSPENDED`, or `BANNED`). `null` for participants who are not affiliates.

allMatchingFraudsters.description: Other participants flagged as matching this participant during anti-fraud checks.

createdAt.description: When the participant joined, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

fingerprint.description: Browser identifier recorded for the participant, or `null`.

impressionCount.description: Total views of the participant's referral link.

ipAddress.description: IP address recorded for the participant, or `null`.

isAffiliate.description: Affiliate programs only. Whether this participant is an enrolled affiliate. A referred customer who has not joined the program is `false`.

isNew.description: `true` when the request created the participant. Returned by participant creation calls.

isWinner.description: `true` once the participant has earned at least one reward.

leadCount.description: Pending referrals that have not converted yet.

mobileInstanceId.description: App-install scoped identifier supplied by a native app, or `null`.

monthlyReferrals.description: Ids of participants they successfully referred this month (100 most recent).

notes.description: Internal notes. Never shown to participants.

payoutSettings.description: Actions the participant must complete before a payout can be released. Always present.

requiredActions.description: Actions required before payouts can be sent. Empty when no action is required.

paypalEmailAddress.description: PayPal email address on file, used for affiliate or PayPal reward payouts.

referralCount.description: All-time referrals credited to the participant.

referralSource.description: How the participant joined the program.

referralStatus.description: The referrer's credit status for this participant. Present only when the participant was referred.

referrals.description: Ids of participants they successfully referred (100 most recent).

referredBy.description: Id of the referrer. Present only when the participant was referred.

referrer.description: Summary of the participant's referrer (same core fields as a participant). Present only when the participant was referred.

rewardEvidence.description: What this response establishes about rewards. Combine with other reads; unknown here does not override evidence elsewhere.

approvalPolicy.description: Referral reward approval policy from requireManualRewardApproval, not affiliate commission approval or an individual reward state.

automaticFulfillmentMarking.description: The autoFulfillRewards setting, when returned by an options read. Null means unknown; this controls marking, not delivery.

items.description: A reward earned by the participant (`ParticipantReward`), distinct from a Campaign Reward configuration (`CampaignReward`).

approvedAt.description: When the reward was approved, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. `null` until approved.

commissionStructure.description: Commission configuration attached to this reward. Present only for affiliate programs.

fulfilledAt.description: When the reward was marked fulfilled, as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. `null` until marked fulfilled; this is not a delivery receipt.

isAvailable.description: `true` if the reward is available for the participant to claim or redeem.

isFulfilled.description: `true` once the reward is marked fulfilled. Confirm actual delivery through fulfillment records.

isReferrer.description: `true` if earned as the referrer, `false` if earned as the referred friend (double-sided rewards).

referredId.description: Id of the friend that was referred.

referrerId.description: Id of the participant that made the referral.

rewardId.description: ID of the Campaign Reward (`CampaignReward`) that was earned.

status.description: Fulfillment marking of the earned reward. `FULFILLED` records that it was marked fulfilled, not proof of delivery. `CANCELLED` means an unpaid Lead reward was reversed before fulfillment.

unread.description: `true` until the participant sees the reward in a GrowSurf window.

shareUrl.description: The participant's unique referral link. Omitted for affiliate program participants who are not approved affiliates.

uniqueImpressionCount.description: Unique views of the participant's referral link.

unreadCommissionsCount.description: Commissions the participant has not yet viewed. Affiliate programs only.

unreadPayoutsCount.description: Payouts the participant has not yet viewed. Affiliate programs only.

unsubscribed.description: `true` if the participant unsubscribed from program emails.

title: Get Participant
